_doc: AQG Hook 强化 — managed hook 集把 CLAUDE.md rule 落到强制执行点. 复制 hooks block 到 ~/.claude/settings.json (用户级, 跨所有项目) 或 .claude/settings.json (项目级). 需要 export AQG_ROOT=/path/to/agent-quality-gates 才生效; 未设则 silent skip 不阻塞 Claude. 推荐使用 scripts/install_aqg_hooks.py --apply 自动合并而非手动复制. POSIX (macOS/Linux) only.
_blocking_contract: AQG blocking contract: per-command `_blocking: true` marks intentionally blocking entries (PreToolUse Bash skill-validator + PreToolUse Edit|Write|MultiEdit memory-write-guard). validate_agent_pack.py honors this marker to skip warn-only checks for just those commands; all other hooks in this file remain validated as warn-only. File-level `_warn_only: false` is REJECTED to prevent contract drift (per audit gpt-5.5 #3).

_layers.PreToolUse(Bash): BLOCKING: skill-validator gate; staged 或 -a/git-add 阶段 含 skills/aqg-* 改动则跑 validator; 失败 exit 2 阻 commit (PreToolUse deny code; exit 1 非阻塞) (AQG_AGENT=human-opt-in 可降级 warn)
_layers.PreToolUse(Edit|Write|MultiEdit): BLOCKING: memory→repo write guard; 目标在 ~/.claude/projects/*/memory/ 且新内容含代码-形状信号 (fenced code / def/class/function 声明) 则 exit 2 reject (PreToolUse deny code; exit 1 非阻塞); machine-local memory 不是工程知识的家 (bug 修复+守卫应进仓库 code/test/docs/hooks) (AQG_AGENT=human-opt-in 可降级 warn)
_layers.PreToolUse(Edit|Write|MultiEdit) tamper-: BLOCKING (D3 默认装): 从 AQG checkout 之外编辑 AQG 门文件 (agent-packs/*/hooks/*.sh / _secret_patterns.py / *_redaction.py / aqg_dangerous_guard.py) 则 exit 2 refuse; 威胁模型=跨项目 blast-radius (别的 repo 里的 agent 篡改 AQG 门), 非 agent 自防 (shell-capable agent 总能写自己 env); cwd 在 AQG_ROOT 内=自研放行 (AQG_AGENT=human-opt-in 可降级 warn)
_layers.PostToolUse(Bash, error): WARN: Bash 命令失败 (is_error=true) 后提示 aqg-systematic-debugging 6 步: symptom→reproduce→boundary→hypothesis→fix→verify
_layers.PostToolUse(Edit|Write|MultiEdit, skills: WARN: skill edit 后提示 commit 前调 aqg-skill-validator
_layers.PostToolUse(Edit|Write|MultiEdit, code f: WARN: code edit 后提示 aqg-code-construction 6 步 (Phase 1 warn-only; Phase 2 升级为 enforce)
_layers.PostToolUse(Edit|Write|MultiEdit, test f: WARN: test edit 后提示 aqg-test-quality-review: BEHAVIOR vs SHAPE / horizontal-slicing / test_suppression / flaky 反模式
_layers.PostToolUse(Edit|Write|MultiEdit, securi: WARN: 安全敏感 code edit (路径关键词 OR 内容 OWASP 模式) 后提示 aqg-security-review (OWASP Top 10 + CWE Top 25); 普通 code edit 不触发
_layers.PreCompact + Stop: WARN: 提示 aqg-evidence-closeout 6 问已答否 + aqg-session-handoff (任务未完则给下一棒留 paste-ready 交接); wip_checkpoint_save 把当前 worktree 改动(含 untracked)快照到 refs/aqg-wip/<session> (零碰工作树/index/分支, 本地不外向)
_layers.SessionStart: INFO: 自动跑 aqg-startup-preflight (20s timeout 防 hang) + 打印 worktree/GH 摘要; wip_checkpoint_recover 提示未恢复的 checkpoint (只提示不自动改工作树); 与 wip_save/recover 信标互补 (信标存计数, checkpoint 存代码)
_layers.UserPromptSubmit: INJECT (warn-only, never blocks): 用户 prompt 含 handoff 意图 (handoff / 交接 / 下个 session / next session) 时注入 additionalContext 强制调 aqg-session-handoff skill (禁止自由发挥写 handoff); 非 handoff prompt 静默不注入 (反 noise)
